info.title: Scena Workspace Capacity and Connected Content API
info.description: Source contract for authoritative Workspace usage, provider-neutral incoming webhook addresses, and tenant-scoped live menu feeds. This contract is not a production deployment claim.

post.summary: Load account, Workspace, effective tier, and current usage context

200.description: Each Workspace includes effective entitlements and usage/remaining resource metrics.

post.summary: Manage or ingest a connected content source
post.description: Manager actions require a Supabase JWT. Generic providers receive a unique source URL and one-time bearer secret, then send event metadata plus an arbitrary JSON data object. Managed KpnSolute providers use a Standard Webhooks signature, CloudEvents 1.0 envelope, and tenant match. KpnCompute menu connections subscribe to day and cycle events and retain a merged last-known-good snapshot.

201.description: Connection registered; bootstrap result is reported separately from registration.

403.description: Workspace role or provider tenant mismatch.

422.description: Event type, timestamp, envelope, or provider payload is invalid.
